assets.name: Liefz fern · 01
assets.card_evidence: Distinct author-supplied frond arrangements (48 and 150 triangles), not the paired mirror/rotation variants. UV-mapped curved frond sheets use the included RGBA fern atlas.
assets.material_setup: The archive references an absent Fern_01.mtl. Preserve the OBJ; assign the included RGBA atlas to the whole model. Alpha mode, cutoff and sidedness are unspecified by the source.

preview.mask_note: Sidecar atlas hookup; 0.5 cutoff and two-sided rendering are preview assumptions.
